title: MusicDrop v1.4.2 Available
changelog:
• True Edge-to-Edge Top Video Surface: Video runs all the way to the top edge behind the status bar and floating top bar scrim without any purple gap or bar overlap
• Music Player Themes & Skin Selection: Restored Player Themes (18 distinct visual themes) and Player Skin layouts (Vinyl Turntable, Radial Ring, Ring & Drawer, Modern Card, Scenic Wallpaper) directly accessible from the 3-dots menu
• Full App & Player Theme Synchronization: Switching app themes (YouTube Music, Pulse, Orbit, Greenroom, Cyber Dark, OLED Black, etc.) automatically syncs player theme, background gradients, bottom docked sheet colors, and scrubber accents
